attributes.title: [SRE] DB slowness walkthrough ES|QL
attributes.description: Discover tabs for the DB slowness walkthrough dashboard. Each tab is named after the panel title and runs that panel's ES|QL. Time picker default last 3 days (?_tstart / ?_tend).

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query": {"esql": "FROM traces-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE `attributes.span.destination.service.resource` == "postgresql"
| WHERE `attributes.span.duration.us` >= 1000000
| STATS slow_spans = COUNT(*)"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM traces-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE `attributes.span.destination.service.resource` == "postgresql"
| WHERE `attributes.span.duration.us` >= 1000000
| STATS max_s = ROUND(MAX(`attributes.span.duration.us`) / 1000000.0, 1)"}, "filter": []}

tabs.label: 1. Apps with a slow DB span

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query": {"esql": "FROM traces-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE `attributes.span.destination.service.resource` == "postgresql"
| WHERE `attributes.span.duration.us` >= 1000000
| STATS apps = COUNT_DISTINCT(`resource.attributes.service.name`)"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM metrics-aws.rds-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
    AND `aws.dimensions.DBInstanceIdentifier` == "apm-classic-stage-rds"
| STATS cpu_pct = ROUND(MAX(`aws.rds.cpu.total.pct`) * 100.0, 1)"}, "filter": []}

tabs.label: 2. Slow postgresql spans (≥1s) by RDS host

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query": {"esql": "FROM traces-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
    AND `attributes.span.destination.service.resource` == "postgresql"
    AND `attributes.span.duration.us` >= 1000000
| EVAL rds_short = CASE(
     COALESCE(`attributes.server.address`, `attributes.net.peer.name`) LIKE "*classic-stage-rds*", "classic-stage-rds",
     COALESCE(`attributes.server.address`, `attributes.net.peer.name`) LIKE "*perf-db1*", "meridium-perf-db1",
     COALESCE(`attributes.server.address`, `attributes.net.peer.name`) LIKE "*alerts-postgres*", "alerts-postgres",
     COALESCE(`attributes.server.address`, `attributes.net.peer.name`) LIKE "*cases-postgres*", "cases-postgres",
     COALESCE(`attributes.server.address`, `attributes.net.peer.name`) LIKE "*iam-uaa-postgres*", "iam-uaa-postgres",
     COALESCE(`attributes.server.address`, `attributes.net.peer.name`)
   )
| STATS slow = COUNT(*)
    BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), rds_short
| KEEP t, rds_short, slow
| SORT t ASC
| LIMIT 2000"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM traces-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE `attributes.span.destination.service.resource` == "postgresql"
| WHERE `attributes.span.duration.us` >= 1000000
| STATS slow = COUNT(*),
        p95_ms = ROUND(PERCENTILE(`attributes.span.duration.us`, 95) / 1000.0, 1),
        max_ms = ROUND(MAX(`attributes.span.duration.us`) / 1000.0, 1)
    BY app = `resource.attributes.service.name`,
       rds = COALESCE(`attributes.server.address`, `attributes.net.peer.name`)
| SORT slow DESC
| LIMIT 20"}, "filter": []}

tabs.label: 4. Slow SQL (FROM table excerpt from db.query.text)

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query": {"esql": "FROM traces-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE `attributes.span.destination.service.resource` == "postgresql"
| WHERE `attributes.span.duration.us` >= 1000000
| WHERE `attributes.db.query.text` IS NOT NULL
| EVAL from_at = LOCATE(`attributes.db.query.text`, "FROM ")
| EVAL sql = SUBSTRING(`attributes.db.query.text`, from_at, 72)
| STATS slow = COUNT(*),
        p95_ms = ROUND(PERCENTILE(`attributes.span.duration.us`, 95) / 1000.0, 1),
        max_ms = ROUND(MAX(`attributes.span.duration.us`) / 1000.0, 1)
    BY app = `resource.attributes.service.name`, sql
| SORT max_ms DESC
| LIMIT 15"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM traces-generic.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
    AND `attributes.span.destination.service.resource` == "postgresql"
    AND `attributes.span.duration.us` >= 5000000
| EVAL dur_s = ROUND(`attributes.span.duration.us` / 1000000.0, 1),
       from_at = LOCATE(COALESCE(`attributes.db.query.text`, ""), "FROM "),
       sql = SUBSTRING(COALESCE(`attributes.db.query.text`, ""), from_at, 64),
       rds = COALESCE(`attributes.server.address`, `attributes.net.peer.name`)
| SORT `attributes.span.duration.us` DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, `resource.attributes.service.name`, rds, dur_s, `trace.id`, sql
| LIMIT 15"}, "filter": []}

tabs.label: 6. Search EntityDeleted logs (DEW fan-out) — click trace.id

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-kubernetes.container_logs.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
    AND `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name` == "apm-classic-meridium-service-search"
    AND NOT `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name` == "datadog-agent-injected"
    AND `body.text` LIKE "*EntityDeleted*"
| EVAL msg = SUBSTRING(`body.text`, 1, 180)
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, `resource.attributes.k8s.pod.name`, `trace.id`, msg
| LIMIT 20"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-kubernetes.container_logs.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
    AND `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name` == "apm-classic-meridium-webapi"
    AND NOT `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name` == "datadog-agent-injected"
    AND TO_LOWER(`body.text`) RLIKE ".*(error|exception).*"
    AND NOT `body.text` LIKE "*DuplicateTriggerTimeout*"
| EVAL msg = SUBSTRING(`body.text`, 1, 180)
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, `trace.id`, msg
| LIMIT 15"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-ingress-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
    AND url.domain == "apm-classic-stage.apm.stage.usw02.15.energy"
    AND (
      url.path LIKE "/api/v1/core/queryengine*"
      OR url.path LIKE "/api/v1/search*"
      OR `http.response.status_code` >= 400
    )
| EVAL path = SUBSTRING(url.path, 1, 64)
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, `http.request.method`, path, `http.response.status_code`, `trace.id`
| LIMIT 20"}, "filter": []}

{"query": {"esql": "FROM metrics-aws.rds-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
    AND `aws.dimensions.DBInstanceIdentifier` == "apm-classic-stage-rds"
| STATS cpu_pct_max = ROUND(MAX(`aws.rds.cpu.total.pct`) * 100.0, 1),
        cpu_pct_avg = ROUND(AVG(`aws.rds.cpu.total.pct`) * 100.0, 2),
        max_queue = ROUND(MAX(`aws.rds.disk_queue_depth`), 2),
        max_read_s = ROUND(MAX(`aws.rds.latency.read`), 4),
        max_write_s = ROUND(MAX(`aws.rds.latency.write`), 4)
| KEEP cpu_pct_max, cpu_pct_avg, max_queue, max_read_s, max_write_s"}, "filter": []}
